tasks.name: Count the shiny drops
tasks.prompt: How many shiny water drops can you count?
tasks.hint: Count each bright drop one by one.

tasks.name: Match the water flowers
tasks.prompt: Match each sleepy flower with its shining blossom ring.
tasks.hint: Pick a flower, then click the blossom ring that matches it.

tasks.name: Tap the splash stones
tasks.prompt: Tap the splash stones in order: 1, 2, 3, 4.
tasks.hint: Start at splash stone 1 and keep going.

tasks.name: Drag sparkles into the stream
tasks.prompt: Drag the bright sparkles into the stream rings.
tasks.hint: Pick up a sparkle and drop it inside a stream ring.

tasks.name: Restore the waterfall song
tasks.prompt: Drag the sparkling crystal to the glowing stand.
tasks.hint: The glowing stand at the top of the waterfall is ready now.
